description: Search vape product offers from retail shops. Each result is one shop's offer with brand, model, category, price, stock status, variants, ratings and a sourceUrl on Vaper.club. Cite sourceUrl when using the data. Missing fields mean unknown, not zero.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the shop.

language.description: Language code such as en or de. Defaults to the site default language.

query.description: Search keywords, for example a product, model or flavor name.

name: search_products
title: Search products
